title: Aspherical $PD_4$-pairs
summary: This is the third of three related preprints. We consider here which groups $π$ and $PD_3$-complexes $Y$ are realised by $PD_4$-pairs $(X,Y)$ with $X$ aspherical and $π_1X\congπ$, and show that such a pair may be assembled from $(D^4,S^3)$ and $PD_4$-pairs of groups, by adding 1-handles and mapping cylinders of $\mathbb{Z}π_1N$-homology equivalences over boundary components $N$, if and only if $H^2(π;\mathbb{Z}π)=0$.
